issue.title: Record that Z opens a read-only owned image viewer and leaves native clicks native
issue.description: Consolidates bob-cli-a1.1 note #1, bob-cli-a1.2 note #1, and bob-cli-a1.3 note #1. The accepted feature and rationale are in plan:202610/z_image_zoom.md and research:202610/obsidian_z_image_inspection/obsidian_z_image_inspection.md; implementation is in bob-plugins commits 7c6d037, 5e21b03, and 049f466. Add the planned decisions strand after the memory task is authorized, using Applies to, Claim, Why (with rejected alternatives), Cost, and Reopens when. This is deliberately deferred memory work, not a blocker for bob-cli-a1. Search across all task statuses, the last-week sweep, and active epic scopes found no duplicate or separate causal epic. Small because the accepted text, evidence and target path already exist in the plan; no design research is needed.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Record that Z opens a public-API plugin-owned read-only viewer for the image on the cursor line, while native click and Zoom-button behavior stays native. Document why click interception/community lightboxes, undocumented native delegation and resizing verbs were rejected, the maintenance cost, and reopening if Bryan prefers native feel after v1. Cite the accepted research and implementing commits; republish with sase memory init.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-a1 phases .1, .2, and .3 each proposed this skipped memory change; the automatic image_zoom_record=no decision had no human review and requires preserving the follow-up.
